articles.title: Letter: Thanks to the Eastgate Volunteer Fire Co.
body: To the editor: I have lived on Dayton Terrace for 8 years, and I want to say what a difference the Eastgate Volunteer Fire Co. has made. Please keep the second recycling drop-off in the budget. Many of us on Dayton Terrace use it every week.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the May meeting.
Ellis Lindqvist, Eastgate
